name: Shanghai Smart Control Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Smart Control Co., Ltd., a Chinese enterprise, concentrates on the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of automated control solutions within China. The company's diverse portfolio includes display units, various types of controllers, integrated display-controllers, input/output (IO) modules, keypads, sensors, and cameras. These advanced products are widely utilized across numerous industries such as heavy construction equipment, emergency vehicles, agricultural machinery, mining apparatus, municipal sanitation vehicles, specialized transport, petroleum industry equipment, new energy applications, marine and port machinery, railway systems, industrial automation, and other associated domains. Established in 2005, Shanghai Smart Control Co., Ltd. is based in Shanghai, China.
